claims.claim: Stage 10 evaluator generates independent fresh-launch commands for two map profiles and three policy variants, including checkpoint hash, terminal stop, replay save, and report paths.
Raw player_result values are normalized to mission terminal state and action traces preserve loop and dispatch attribution.
The evaluator attempted six fresh runtime matrix entries, but none reached API/CreateGame/JoinGame because the approved launcher reported an external SC2_RUNTIME_BUSY owner.

A current-map dead-of-night rollout reached API, CreateGame, JoinGame, frame advancement, successful actions, and replay save for 2048 decisions, but did not observe a mission player_result before the bounded cutoff.

The fresh DebugMode current-map run bypassed commander selection, minimized the API bootstrap window, entered dead-of-night through CreateGame+JoinGame, completed 2048 decisions with 578 successful actions, saved a replay, and produced a clean same-window ScriptError verdict; no player_result was observed.
No terminal result or win rate is reported; P2 remains native Computer and the live evaluation boundary is unresolved.
The current live runner uses DirectMapApi with join_existing=true; the raw session skips CreateGame and retries JoinGame after transient API disconnects.
The first fresh DirectMapApi runtime attempt on port 6004 was rejected before API readiness by an external SC2 runtime lease; it provides no map-entry or victory evidence.

PPO exploration stabilization now applies ent_floor as a differentiable low-entropy penalty; a 96-step dead-of-night simulator smoke run with ent_coef=0.05 and ent_floor=0.5 completed with finite losses, stable entropy, and reproducible report/checkpoint metadata.

SC2 API readiness is decided by a real /sc2api websocket handshake plus a protobuf Ping, never by a bare TCP connect; the report records api_ready_basis and the runner aborts if the launcher process exits while waiting.
A blocked live run always names its cause: runtime_gate_failures lists the failed gates and blocked_reason is runtime_gate_failed:<causes>, so no run can be blocked with an empty reason.

The live default packed map is pinned to the known-good artifact by path, size and md5, and the pin is guarded by a test that was itself verified with a negative control (reverting the default to the broken repack fails the suite).

A single-variable A/B over identical code, parameters and 128 steps proves the 20260809-23:33 repack of the packed dead-of-night map never hands the player a faction: 1 placeholder unit, 0 minerals, 0/128 successful actions, while the Jul-31 artifact yields 2 own units, 50 minerals, 27 visible enemies and 66/128 successful actions. api_ready, CreateGame, JoinGame and frame advancement are true on both arms, so this is a map-artifact regression, not a transport defect.

The Stage 5 512-step rung passed on the known-good artifact with the commander max-level gate: 512 decisions through loop 4096, 213 successful actions, 8 distinct actions, action entropy 1.860 nats, illegal action rate 0.0, clean same-window ScriptError verdict and a saved native replay. No mission player_result was observed, so no victory is claimed.

The Stage 5 2048-step rung passed on the known-good artifact: 2048 decisions through loop 16384, 874 successful actions, 8 distinct actions, action entropy 1.868 nats, illegal action rate 0.0, clean ScriptError verdict and a saved native replay. No mission player_result was observed, so no victory is claimed.

No currently available packed artifact grants the player a commander economy: the census is flat from loop 1024 to loop 16384 at own_unit_count=2, minerals=50 and supply_cap=0, and build/produce/gather actions are chosen zero times. Stage 6 mission terminal evidence is therefore structurally unreachable today, and the census now reports terminal_evidence_reachable=false for this state instead of labelling it a started mission.

The commander max-level gate passed for Raynor at level 15 with full mastery on every accepted run, but commander_evidence_source is config and commander_runtime_proven is false; the profile is declared, not read back from the runtime.

claims.statement: The map-aware checkpoint drives 8192 live decision steps (game loops 0 to 65536) on real SC2 through the approved launcher with 3298 successful action results, 8 distinct actions, action entropy 1.8735 nats, 0 illegal actions and 0 ScriptError, and the native replay is saved.

claims.statement: The live bridge is horizon-stable: across 512, 2048 and 8192 steps the action success rate stays in a narrow band (41.6 percent, 42.7 percent, 40.3 percent) and reward_mean moves only from -1.1494 to -1.1499, so the Stage 5 evidence is not an artefact of short rollouts.

claims.notes: Rules out 'the base just had not spawned yet' as an explanation for EVAL-009. A 16x longer horizon changes nothing, so Stage 6 remains structurally unreachable on this artifact.

claims.statement: A mid-rollout SC2 websocket loss fails closed: the aborted attempt recorded status=failed, runtime_gate=false, runtime_gate_failures=['step_budget_not_met'], replay_saved=false and 18 of 8192 steps, so a partial run cannot be presented as Stage 5 evidence.

claims.statement: The CMRE Reborn initialization trigger chain does not execute during a live API run: the launcher zeroes CMRERebornDebug.SC2Bank at launch and after 65536 game loops the bank is still entirely zero (159 keys, nonzero_ints=0, folders 1/2/14), with initialization_gate_started=0 and bridge_heartbeat_started=0.
claims.notes: Independent of the SC2 API. Converts EVAL-009 from 'the map does not grant an economy' into a single checkable acceptance signal: initialization_gate_started must become non-zero.

claims.claim: Packing the approved launcher's overlayed staging directory produces an artifact that finally brings the co-op commander economy online: a single-variable 256-step A/B reports commander_economy_online=true, supply 15/15, 15 SCV plus a CommandCenter, 535 minerals, illegal action rate 0.0 and reward_sum=+2577.95, against supply_cap=0 and reward_sum=-587.65 on the previous default. terminal_evidence_reachable flips false to true.

The live-run default map is repinned to the overlay artifact (md5 ccc74e2c6fff5b1914d196b5867705c5, 3328542 B) and the pin test now names four superseded artifacts as explicit negative arms. faction_initialised alone is no longer accepted as the pin criterion, because the previous default satisfied it while leaving supply_cap at 0 forever; the source comment is required to document commander_economy_online.

The CMRE debug bank is captured per-run instead of being read out of band. snapshot_initialization_banks() copies every CMRERebornDebug.SC2Bank under the SC2 Banks root into the run's own output directory before the launcher dies, and merges account-scoped copies with max so a zeroed account copy cannot mask a root write. Four unit tests cover the fired case, a zeroed negative control, the account-copy masking case, and a missing bank root.

The first Stage 6 long-horizon attempt failed at JoinGame for a scheduling reason, not an artifact reason: the launcher log records the SC2 process it had just brought up on port 5972 (PID 29720) exiting between CreateGame and JoinGame while a concurrent galaxy-vibe transport probe was cycling SC2 on port 5000. The real-machine slot is a single global resource, so concurrent lines preempt each other.

No mission player_result has been observed yet, so Stage 6 and Stage 10 remain blocked. The blocker changed character: it is no longer structural (the commander economy is online and a terminal is reachable), it is simply not yet observed.

The overlay artifact runs a real mission end to end: the 04:55 Stage 6 attempt joined the game, advanced frames to loop 24112 (~18 minutes of mission time), landed 188 successful actions and produced zero ScriptErrors.

That run was ended by external preemption, not by the map, the policy or the horizon: the runtime lease heartbeat stopped at 05:02:15 and a foreign SC2Switcher on port 5000 started at 05:02:18, three seconds later.

The per-run bank snapshot could be destroyed by an unrelated directory. Path.glob descended into the self-nested .runtime-lab-backup-* chain and raised WinError 3; iter_debug_banks() now prunes it and finds all 4 banks on the real Banks root.

Stage 6 exposure was cut from ~32 min to ~12 min of wall clock by raising step_mul from 8 to 32. Measured throughput was ~8.4 policy steps/s regardless of loops per step, so 6000 steps x 32 covers ~143 minutes of mission time - far past a full match - inside the competing hourly session's gap.

The long-horizon Stage 6 run completed uninterrupted: 6000 steps at step_mul 32 = 192,000 game loops (~143 minutes of mission time), join_game=true, frame_advancement=true, 0 ScriptErrors, replay saved (1.41 MB), bank snapshots captured. It was not preempted.
No player_result was produced. terminal_observed=false and terminal_results=[] after 192,000 loops, which falsifies the hypothesis that Stage 6 was blocked by an insufficient horizon.

That cutoff was written out as status=passed with runtime_gate_failures=[], and the guard filed it as final_outcome='terminal'. Both checkers were green on the single question Stage 6 exists to answer.

Both false greens are closed. --require-terminal makes a terminal-evidence run fail-closed and names its structural cause; the guard's classify() now keys only on terminal_observed. Replaying the real report through the new helper fails precisely on this criterion, and require_terminal=False leaves other stages untouched.

The engine rejected 5950 of 6000 orders (NotSupported 3485, Error 2450, Success 50 = 0.83%) while illegal_action_rate reported 0.0, because that metric measures mask compliance rather than engine acceptance. runtime_action_success_rate and runtime_action_result_distribution are now first-class report fields.

The two-point census mislabelled the run 'partial_faction:units_without_commander_economy' - the broken-artifact verdict - although the same artifact records 'faction_initialised' on short runs. A supply-cap high-water mark now separates 'never came online' from 'came online and collapsed'.

That boolean skips all P1/P2 ownership checks because the RL harness never sets CreateStartingUnitsP1 / EnsurePreventDefeatP1
Stage 6 attempt 3 ran 192,000 loops with player_id 1 owning zero units and zero supply at step 0, while all init markers read 1
The empty start is not specific to the long run: the accepted 512-step run starts identically empty
A host-side precondition refuses the empty-faction rollout before it consumes the exclusive real-machine slot

The approved launcher now writes a max-level/full-mastery commander profile by default: CommanderLevel=15 is written for P1/P2, six-slot commanders get MasteryLevel=180 with all six mastery values at 30, and the ML runner blocks a declared-full run whose mastery layout is not actually full before starting SC2.

The live runner now reads only a fresh CMCoopLaunchProfile bank from the current launch window: its player-1 CommanderLevel/mastery fields override the CLI declaration and set commander_runtime_proven only when the bank is current. A stale bank is copied for diagnosis but cannot make the commander gate pass. The runner also prefers pwsh over Windows PowerShell when pwsh is installed.

The post-fix approved-launcher smoke on port 6015 reached SC2 API readiness, CreateGame, JoinGame, frame advancement and action results with zero same-window ScriptErrors. Its fresh launch-profile bank proves player 1 is TerranRaynor at CommanderLevel=15 with MasteryLevel=180, MasteryCount=6 and six mastery values of 30; the report records commander_runtime_proven=true. This is commander configuration/runtime evidence only, not a mission victory claim.

The repeatable train/eval loop now passes an explicit simulator control interval and optional starting resources into the shared training CLI, persists those values in the training report, and refreshes the evaluation plan after training so the final checkpoint SHA-256 is materialised instead of remaining pending.

A fresh terminal-intent run with --stop-on-terminal and --require-terminal was rejected by the approved launcher before API readiness because the external SC2 runtime lease was still owned by another detached session; it produced no CreateGame, JoinGame, action, or terminal evidence.

An end-to-end train-only cycle persisted train-eval-report.json with status=trained_only and a checkpoint hash matching the post-training evaluation plan hash; the report records 64 simulator steps at step_loops=64 with start_minerals=200.

Commander validation now requires the observed bank commander identity to match the requested commander in addition to level 15 and full six-slot mastery; a maxed TerranAlenger3 bank is rejected for a TerranRaynor request.

The 20260811 terminal-intent launcher reached a real API Ping on port 6018, but the controller did not produce a session report before that API disappeared; a later attached diagnostic timed out and has no game, action, or terminal evidence. Its globally written Alenger3 bank is not attributed to the interrupted Raynor launch.
